The District Health Society, Sheikhpura prepares its PIP each financial year, which is consolidated by the State Health Society, Bihar and approved by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare through the Record of Proceedings. posts.Title: World Breastfeeding Week 2026
posts.Short_Description: District-level awareness activities are being organised across Sheikhpura to promote breastfeeding and improve maternal and child health outcomes.
posts.Full_Description:
The District Health Society, Sheikhpura is observing World Breastfeeding Week with awareness activities across all six blocks. Activities include mothers' meetings at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, counselling sessions on early initiation and exclusive breastfeeding, rallies by ASHA workers and Anganwadi sevikas, and orientation of frontline workers on IYCF practices.

Block-level teams will report daily activity counts to the DPMU. Facility in-charges are requested to ensure that every delivery point displays IYCF messaging and that breastfeeding counselling is recorded in the mother's case sheet.

posts.Title: District Health Camp — PHC Chewara
posts.Short_Description: A full-day health camp offering general OPD, NCD screening, eye check-up, anaemia testing and ABHA registration.
posts.Full_Description:
A district-level health camp will be organised at PHC Chewara covering general OPD, non-communicable disease screening, eye check-up, anaemia testing and ABHA registration.

Specialist doctors from Sadar Hospital will be deputed for the day. Free medicines will be provided under the Free Drug Service Initiative. Community mobilisation will be carried out by ASHA workers in the preceding week.

posts.Short_Description: Every health sub-centre in the district is now onboarded to the BHAVYA platform with daily reporting and full ABHA generation coverage.
posts.Full_Description:
Sheikhpura district has achieved full ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) generation coverage at all health sub-centres, with every HSC now onboarded to the BHAVYA platform and reporting daily.

The district recorded consistent improvement in teleconsultation uptake and vitals capture over the review period. The Civil Surgeon has commended the block teams and Community Health Officers for sustained data entry discipline.
posts.Author: District M&E Officer

posts.Title: Two-Day CHO Training on CPHC Service Packages
posts.Short_Description: Training for Community Health Officers on the twelve CPHC service packages, teleconsultation protocols and BHAVYA reporting.
posts.Full_Description:
A two-day training programme on Comprehensive Primary Health Care service packages will be conducted for Community Health Officers posted at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs.

Sessions will cover the twelve service packages, teleconsultation protocols, NCD screening workflow, and reporting through the BHAVYA platform. Participants must bring their facility login credentials.
posts.Venue: District Training Centre, Sadar Hospital Campus
posts.Author: District Programme Manager

posts.Title: Monthly District Health Society Review Meeting
posts.Short_Description: Monthly review chaired by the District Magistrate. Programme officers must attend with FMR-wise expenditure and physical progress statements.
posts.Full_Description: The monthly review meeting of the District Health Society will be chaired by the District Magistrate. All programme officers and block health managers are required to attend with FMR-wise expenditure statements and physical progress against approved PIP targets for the current financial year.
posts.Author: District Programme Manager

posts.Title: Special Measles-Rubella Vaccination Drive
posts.Short_Description: District-wide MR vaccination drive for children aged 9 months to 5 years, with session sites at Anganwadi centres, schools and health facilities.
posts.Full_Description:
A special measles-rubella vaccination drive will be conducted across all blocks of Sheikhpura district targeting children in the 9 months to 5 years age group.

Session sites will be organised at Anganwadi centres, schools and health facilities. Micro-plans have been shared with block teams. Cold chain readiness has been verified at all points.
posts.Author: District Immunisation Officer

posts.Title: Revised Monthly Reporting Format for Ayushman Arogya Mandirs
posts.Short_Description: Updated AAM reporting format takes effect this quarter, capturing teleconsultation counts, disaggregated NCD screening and ABHA linkage status.
posts.Full_Description:
Revised monthly reporting formats for Ayushman Arogya Mandirs take effect from this quarter. The updated format captures teleconsultation counts, NCD screening disaggregated by age band, and ABHA linkage status.

The format is available in the Documents section of this portal. Block Programme Managers must ensure all facilities switch to the new format from the current reporting month.
posts.Author: District M&E Officer

posts.Title: World TB Day 2026 Observed Across the District
posts.Short_Description: Awareness rallies, screening camps and Ni-kshay Mitra felicitation were held across all blocks to mark World TB Day.
posts.Full_Description: World TB Day was observed with awareness rallies, active case-finding camps and felicitation of Ni-kshay Mitras who have supported nutritional assistance to TB patients in the district.
posts.Author: District TB Officer

benefits.Benefit_Title: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) — cash for institutional delivery
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: जननी सुरक्षा योजना (JSY) — संस्थागत प्रसव हेतु नकद सहायता
benefits.Benefit_Description: Cash assistance paid directly into the mother's bank account for delivering in a government health facility. Bihar is a Low Performing State, so every pregnant woman is eligible regardless of age, birth order or income.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: सरकारी अस्पताल में प्रसव कराने पर माता के बैंक खाते में सीधे नकद सहायता। बिहार में सभी गर्भवती महिलाएं पात्र हैं — आयु, बच्चों की संख्या या आय की कोई शर्त नहीं।
benefits.Amount: Rs 1,400 rural / Rs 1,000 urban (VERIFY current state rate)
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: All pregnant women delivering in a government or accredited private facility
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Any government health facility in Sheikhpura — Sadar Hospital, CHC, PHC, APHC or Ayushman Arogya Mandir
benefits.Documents_Required: Aadhaar, MCP (Mother and Child Protection) card, bank passbook

benefits.Benefit_Title: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK) — completely free delivery
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: जननी शिशु सुरक्षा कार्यक्रम (JSSK) — पूर्णत: नि:शुल्क प्रसव
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free delivery including caesarean section, free medicines, free tests, free blood, free diet during the stay and free transport both ways. No family should pay anything for a delivery at a government facility.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: नि:शुल्क प्रसव एवं सिजेरियन, नि:शुल्क दवा, जांच, रक्त, भोजन तथा आने-जाने का वाहन। सरकारी अस्पताल में प्रसव पर परिवार को कुछ भी नहीं देना है।
benefits.Amount: Free — no charge of any kind
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Every pregnant woman, and every sick newborn up to 1 year
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Any government health facility in Sheikhpura — Sadar Hospital, CHC, PHC, APHC or Ayushman Arogya Mandir
benefits.Documents_Required: MCP card helps, but care cannot be refused without it

benefits.Benefit_Title: PMSMA — free antenatal check-up on the 9th of every month
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: प्रधानमंत्री सुरक्षित मातृत्व अभियान — हर माह की 9 तारीख को नि:शुल्क जांच
benefits.Benefit_Description: Assured free antenatal check-up by a doctor on the 9th of every month, including all necessary tests and identification of high-risk pregnancies so complications are caught early.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: प्रत्येक माह की 9 तारीख को चिकित्सक द्वारा नि:शुल्क प्रसव पूर्व जांच, आवश्यक परीक्षण एवं जोखिम वाली गर्भावस्था की पहचान।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: All pregnant women in the 2nd and 3rd trimester
benefits.Where_To_Avail: All CHCs, PHCs and Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura, on the 9th of every month

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free ambulance for delivery, referral and drop-back
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: प्रसव, रेफरल एवं घर वापसी हेतु नि:शुल्क एम्बुलेंस
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free ambulance from home to the facility, between facilities on referral, and back home after discharge. Dial 102.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: घर से अस्पताल, रेफरल पर एक अस्पताल से दूसरे, तथा छुट्टी के बाद घर वापस — नि:शुल्क एम्बुलेंस। 102 डायल करें।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Pregnant women and sick newborns
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Call 102 from anywhere in the district

benefits.Benefit_Title: Sick Newborn Care Unit (SNCU) — free newborn intensive care
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: नवजात शिशु देखभाल इकाई (SNCU) — नि:शुल्क गहन चिकित्सा
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free specialised intensive care for sick and premature newborns — warmers, phototherapy for jaundice, oxygen support and round-the-clock nursing.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: बीमार एवं समय से पूर्व जन्मे नवजात शिशुओं हेतु नि:शुल्क गहन चिकित्सा — वार्मर, पीलिया हेतु फोटोथेरेपी, ऑक्सीजन एवं 24 घंटे देखभाल।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Newborns up to 28 days needing intensive care
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura

benefits.Benefit_Title: Nutrition Rehabilitation Centre (NRC) — free treatment for severe malnutrition
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: पोषण पुनर्वास केंद्र (NRC) — गंभीर कुपोषण का नि:शुल्क उपचार
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free 14-day admission with therapeutic feeding, medical treatment and counselling for the mother, plus compensation for the mother's wage loss while she stays.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: गंभीर कुपोषित बच्चों हेतु 14 दिन का नि:शुल्क उपचार, पोषण आहार, परामर्श एवं माता को मजदूरी क्षतिपूर्ति।
benefits.Amount: Free, plus wage compensation to the attending mother (VERIFY rate)
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Children under 5 with Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM)
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura — referral through your ASHA or Anganwadi Sevika

benefits.Benefit_Title: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK) — free child health screening
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: राष्ट्रीय बाल स्वास्थ्य कार्यक्रम (RBSK) — बच्चों की नि:शुल्क जांच
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free screening of children for 30 identified conditions — birth defects, deficiencies, diseases and developmental delays — with free treatment and free surgery where needed, including at tertiary hospitals outside the district.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: 0 से 18 वर्ष के बच्चों की 30 प्रकार की बीमारियों हेतु नि:शुल्क जांच, तथा आवश्यकता पड़ने पर नि:शुल्क इलाज एवं शल्य चिकित्सा।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: All children from birth to 18 years
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Anganwadi centres and government schools — RBSK mobile teams visit on schedule

benefits.Benefit_Title: Home Based Newborn Care — your ASHA visits your newborn
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: गृह आधारित नवजात देखभाल — आशा दीदी घर आकर देखभाल करती हैं
benefits.Benefit_Description: Your ASHA visits the newborn at home on days 3, 7, 14, 21, 28 and 42 to check weight, feeding and danger signs, and refers immediately if anything is wrong.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: आशा दीदी नवजात के घर पर दिन 3, 7, 14, 21, 28 एवं 42 को जाकर वजन, स्तनपान एवं खतरे के लक्षणों की जांच करती हैं।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Every newborn in the village
benefits.Where_To_Avail: At your home — contact your ASHA

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free vaccination for every child
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: हर बच्चे का नि:शुल्क टीकाकरण
benefits.Benefit_Description: All routine childhood vaccines free — BCG, Hepatitis B, OPV, Pentavalent, Rotavirus, PCV, IPV, Measles-Rubella, JE and DPT boosters. Protects against 12 life-threatening diseases.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: सभी नियमित टीके नि:शुल्क — बीसीजी, हेपेटाइटिस बी, पोलियो, पेंटावेलेंट, रोटावायरस, पीसीवी, खसरा-रूबेला आदि। 12 गंभीर बीमारियों से सुरक्षा।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: All children from birth to 5 years
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Village Health and Nutrition Day sessions at the Anganwadi, and Nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir (Health Sub-Centre) or APHC

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free Td vaccination for pregnant women
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: गर्भवती महिलाओं हेतु नि:शुल्क टीडी टीका
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free tetanus-diphtheria vaccination during pregnancy, protecting both mother and newborn against tetanus.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: गर्भावस्था के दौरान नि:शुल्क टीडी टीका, जो माता एवं नवजात दोनों की टिटनेस से रक्षा करता है।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: All pregnant women
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir (Health Sub-Centre) or APHC and VHND sessions

benefits.Benefit_Title: Weekly iron and folic acid tablets for adolescents
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: किशोर-किशोरियों हेतु साप्ताहिक आयरन की गोली
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free weekly iron and folic acid tablets to prevent and treat anaemia, distributed in schools and through Anganwadi centres, with deworming twice a year.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: एनीमिया की रोकथाम हेतु नि:शुल्क साप्ताहिक आयरन एवं फोलिक एसिड की गोलियां, तथा वर्ष में दो बार कृमि नाशक दवा।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: All adolescents 10-19 years, in school and out of school
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Government schools and Anganwadi centres

benefits.Benefit_Title: Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic — free confidential counselling
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: किशोर स्वास्थ्य क्लिनिक — नि:शुल्क एवं गोपनीय परामर्श
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free, confidential counselling and treatment for adolescents on nutrition, menstrual health, mental health, substance use and reproductive health. No parent or referral needed.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: किशोरों हेतु पोषण, मासिक धर्म, मानसिक स्वास्थ्य, नशा एवं प्रजनन स्वास्थ्य पर नि:शुल्क एवं गोपनीय परामर्श। किसी रेफरल की आवश्यकता नहीं।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Adolescents 10-19 years
benefits.Where_To_Avail: AFHC at Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura and designated CHCs

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free contraceptives and family planning counselling
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: नि:शुल्क गर्भनिरोधक एवं परिवार नियोजन परामर्श
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free condoms, oral contraceptive pills, emergency contraceptive pills, IUCD and PPIUCD insertion, and the Antara injectable contraceptive — with counselling to choose what suits you.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: नि:शुल्क कंडोम, गर्भनिरोधक गोलियां, आपातकालीन गोली, कॉपर-टी एवं अंतरा इंजेक्शन, उपयुक्त साधन चुनने हेतु परामर्श सहित।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: All eligible couples
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Any government health facility in Sheikhpura — Sadar Hospital, CHC, PHC, APHC or Ayushman Arogya Mandir; also available from your ASHA

benefits.Benefit_Title: Sterilisation with compensation for wage loss
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: नसबंदी एवं मजदूरी क्षतिपूर्ति
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free male (no-scalpel vasectomy) and female sterilisation with compensation for wage loss and free follow-up care. Male sterilisation is simpler, safer and quicker than female sterilisation.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: नि:शुल्क पुरुष (बिना चीरा) एवं महिला नसबंदी, मजदूरी क्षतिपूर्ति तथा नि:शुल्क फॉलो-अप सहित। पुरुष नसबंदी अधिक सरल एवं सुरक्षित है।
benefits.Amount: Compensation as per current state rate (VERIFY)
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Eligible couples who have completed their family
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Fixed-day services at Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura and CHCs

benefits.Benefit_Title: Anaemia Mukt Bharat — free haemoglobin testing and iron supplements
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: एनीमिया मुक्त भारत — नि:शुल्क हीमोग्लोबिन जांच एवं आयरन
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free haemoglobin testing and iron-folic acid supplementation for children, adolescents, pregnant and lactating women, with treatment for those found anaemic.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: बच्चों, किशोरों तथा गर्भवती एवं धात्री महिलाओं हेतु नि:शुल्क हीमोग्लोबिन जांच, आयरन की गोलियां एवं एनीमिया का उपचार।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Children, adolescents, pregnant and lactating women
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir (Health Sub-Centre) or APHC, Anganwadi centres and schools

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free Kala-azar diagnosis, treatment and wage compensation
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: कालाजार की नि:शुल्क जांच, उपचार एवं मजदूरी क्षतिपूर्ति
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free rapid diagnostic test and single-dose treatment for Kala-azar, plus cash compensation for wage loss during treatment. Bihar carries the highest Kala-azar burden in India, and Sheikhpura is an endemic district.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: कालाजार की नि:शुल्क जांच एवं उपचार, साथ ही उपचार अवधि की मजदूरी क्षतिपूर्ति। बिहार में कालाजार सर्वाधिक है एवं शेखपुरा प्रभावित जिला है।
benefits.Amount: Free treatment plus wage compensation (VERIFY current rate)
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Anyone with fever lasting more than two weeks with an enlarged spleen
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Any government health facility in Sheikhpura — Sadar Hospital, CHC, PHC, APHC or Ayushman Arogya Mandir
benefits.Documents_Required: Aadhaar and bank passbook for the compensation

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free malaria and dengue testing and treatment
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: मलेरिया एवं डेंगू की नि:शुल्क जांच एवं उपचार
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free blood test and full treatment for malaria and dengue at all government facilities, plus free insecticide-treated bed nets in high-risk areas and free indoor spraying.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: सभी सरकारी अस्पतालों में मलेरिया एवं डेंगू की नि:शुल्क जांच एवं पूर्ण उपचार, नि:शुल्क मच्छरदानी एवं छिड़काव सहित।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Anyone with fever
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Any government health facility in Sheikhpura — Sadar Hospital, CHC, PHC, APHC or Ayushman Arogya Mandir; your ASHA can also test for malaria

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free leprosy diagnosis and Multi-Drug Therapy
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: कुष्ठ रोग की नि:शुल्क जांच एवं बहुऔषधि उपचार
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free diagnosis and the complete Multi-Drug Therapy course, which cures leprosy. Free reconstructive surgery and MCR footwear where disability has occurred. Leprosy is curable and is not hereditary.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: कुष्ठ रोग की नि:शुल्क जांच एवं पूर्ण उपचार, जिससे रोग ठीक हो जाता है। दिव्यांगता की स्थिति में नि:शुल्क शल्य चिकित्सा एवं एमसीआर चप्पल। कुष्ठ रोग पूर्णत: ठीक होने वाला रोग है।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Anyone with a pale or reddish skin patch that has lost sensation
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Any government health facility in Sheikhpura — Sadar Hospital, CHC, PHC, APHC or Ayushman Arogya Mandir

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free TB diagnosis and complete treatment
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: टीबी की नि:शुल्क जांच एवं पूर्ण उपचार
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free sputum test, chest X-ray, CBNAAT molecular testing and the full course of anti-TB medicines — including for drug-resistant TB, whose treatment would otherwise cost lakhs of rupees.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: नि:शुल्क बलगम जांच, एक्स-रे, सीबीनाट जांच एवं टीबी की पूरी दवा — दवा प्रतिरोधी टीबी सहित, जिसका निजी इलाज लाखों में होता है।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Anyone coughing for two weeks or more, with fever, weight loss or night sweats
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Any government health facility in Sheikhpura — Sadar Hospital, CHC, PHC, APHC or Ayushman Arogya Mandir — TB units at Sadar Hospital and all CHCs

benefits.Benefit_Title: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana — monthly nutrition money for TB patients
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: नि-क्षय पोषण योजना — टीबी मरीजों हेतु मासिक पोषण राशि
benefits.Benefit_Description: Direct cash transfer into the patient's bank account every month for the full duration of TB treatment, to support the nutrition needed to recover.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: टीबी उपचार की पूरी अवधि तक प्रति माह मरीज के बैंक खाते में सीधे पोषण राशि।
benefits.Amount: Monthly, for the full treatment duration (VERIFY current rate)
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Every notified TB patient, whether treated in the public or private sector
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Automatic on Ni-kshay notification — ask at your TB unit

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free hepatitis B and C testing and treatment
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: हेपेटाइटिस बी एवं सी की नि:शुल्क जांच एवं उपचार
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free screening, confirmatory testing and complete treatment for viral hepatitis B and C. A full hepatitis C cure costs lakhs privately and is provided here free.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: वायरल हेपेटाइटिस बी एवं सी की नि:शुल्क जांच एवं पूर्ण उपचार। निजी इलाज में लाखों का खर्च आता है।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Anyone at risk or with symptoms; all pregnant women are screened routinely
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Treatment centre at Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free anti-rabies vaccine after an animal bite
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: पशु काटने पर नि:शुल्क रेबीज रोधी टीका
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free anti-rabies vaccination, and free rabies immunoglobulin for severe bites. Rabies is always fatal once symptoms begin, but completely preventable with prompt vaccination — wash the wound with soap and water and go the same day.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: पशु काटने पर नि:शुल्क रेबीज रोधी टीका। लक्षण आने के बाद रेबीज लाइलाज है, परंतु समय पर टीका लगवाने से पूर्ण बचाव संभव है। घाव को साबुन-पानी से धोकर उसी दिन अस्पताल जाएं।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Anyone bitten or scratched by a dog, cat, monkey or other animal
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura and all CHCs — go the same day

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free cataract surgery with lens implant
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: नि:शुल्क मोतियाबिंद ऑपरेशन एवं लेंस प्रत्यारोपण
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free cataract operation with an intraocular lens that restores sight, including free pre-operative tests, the lens itself, medicines and follow-up visits.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: नि:शुल्क मोतियाबिंद ऑपरेशन एवं लेंस प्रत्यारोपण, जिससे दृष्टि वापस आती है — जांच, लेंस, दवा एवं फॉलो-अप सहित।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Anyone with cataract, most commonly people above 50
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura and designated CHCs; screening camps are held in villages

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free eye screening and spectacles for school children
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: स्कूली बच्चों की नि:शुल्क आंख जांच एवं चश्मा
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free vision screening in schools and free spectacles for children found to have refractive error, so that poor eyesight never becomes a barrier to education.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: विद्यालयों में नि:शुल्क दृष्टि परीक्षण एवं आवश्यकता होने पर नि:शुल्क चश्मा, ताकि कमजोर दृष्टि पढ़ाई में बाधा न बने।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: School children found to need glasses
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Government schools, through RBSK and NPCB screening teams

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free mental health consultation and medicines
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: नि:शुल्क मानसिक स्वास्थ्य परामर्श एवं दवा
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free consultation, counselling and medicines for depression, anxiety, epilepsy, severe mental illness and substance use. Mental illness is treatable, and seeking help is not a weakness.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: अवसाद, चिंता, मिर्गी, गंभीर मानसिक रोग एवं नशे की लत हेतु नि:शुल्क परामर्श एवं दवा। मानसिक रोग का इलाज संभव है — मदद मांगना कमजोरी नहीं है।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Anyone experiencing mental distress, and their family
benefits.Where_To_Avail: District Mental Health Programme clinic at Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura

benefits.Benefit_Title: Tele-MANAS — free mental health helpline, 24 hours
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: टेली-मानस — नि:शुल्क मानसिक स्वास्थ्य हेल्पलाइन, 24 घंटे
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free and confidential mental health support by phone, at any hour, in Hindi and other languages. Dial 14416.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: नि:शुल्क एवं गोपनीय मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सहायता, दिन-रात कभी भी, हिंदी में। 14416 डायल करें।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Anyone
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Call 14416 from any phone

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free geriatric OPD, physiotherapy and mobility aids
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: वृद्धजनों हेतु नि:शुल्क ओपीडी, फिजियोथेरेपी एवं सहायक उपकरण
benefits.Benefit_Description: A dedicated free OPD for the elderly, free physiotherapy, and free aids such as walking sticks, walkers and hearing aids where needed.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: वृद्धजनों हेतु अलग नि:शुल्क ओपीडी, नि:शुल्क फिजियोथेरेपी एवं आवश्यकतानुसार छड़ी, वॉकर तथा श्रवण यंत्र।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Persons aged 60 years and above
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Geriatric OPD at Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free help to quit tobacco, gutkha and khaini
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: तंबाकू, गुटखा एवं खैनी छोड़ने हेतु नि:शुल्क सहायता
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free counselling and nicotine replacement therapy to help you quit, plus free oral cancer screening for tobacco users. Quitting at any age adds years to life.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: तंबाकू छोड़ने हेतु नि:शुल्क परामर्श एवं दवा, तथा तंबाकू सेवन करने वालों की मुख कैंसर की नि:शुल्क जांच।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Any tobacco user who wants to quit
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Tobacco Cessation Centre at Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free screening for blood pressure, diabetes and common cancers
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: रक्तचाप, मधुमेह एवं आम कैंसर की नि:शुल्क जांच
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free population-based screening for hypertension, diabetes and oral, breast and cervical cancer for everyone aged 30 and above — done by your ASHA at your doorstep and at the Ayushman Arogya Mandir.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: 30 वर्ष से ऊपर सभी व्यक्तियों की उच्च रक्तचाप, मधुमेह तथा मुख, स्तन एवं गर्भाशय ग्रीवा कैंसर की नि:शुल्क जांच — आशा दीदी द्वारा घर पर एवं आयुष्मान आरोग्य मंदिर पर।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Everyone aged 30 years and above
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir (Health Sub-Centre) or APHC; your ASHA also screens during home visits

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free monthly medicines for blood pressure and diabetes
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: रक्तचाप एवं मधुमेह की नि:शुल्क मासिक दवा
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free monthly supply of medicines for hypertension and diabetes, collected close to home from the Ayushman Arogya Mandir instead of travelling to the district hospital every month.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: उच्च रक्तचाप एवं मधुमेह की मासिक दवा नि:शुल्क, अपने नजदीकी आयुष्मान आरोग्य मंदिर से — हर महीने जिला अस्पताल जाने की आवश्यकता नहीं।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Patients diagnosed with hypertension or diabetes
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir (Health Sub-Centre) or APHC

benefits.Benefit_Title: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme — free dialysis
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: प्रधानमंत्री राष्ट्रीय डायलिसिस कार्यक्रम — नि:शुल्क डायलिसिस
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free haemodialysis sessions for kidney failure patients, including all consumables. Private dialysis costs roughly Rs 2,000 per session, needed two or three times a week, indefinitely.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: गुर्दा रोगियों हेतु नि:शुल्क डायलिसिस, सभी सामग्री सहित। निजी अस्पताल में प्रति सत्र लगभग 2,000 रुपये लगते हैं, जो सप्ताह में दो-तीन बार आवश्यक होता है।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Patients with chronic kidney disease requiring dialysis
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Dialysis unit at Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free hearing screening and hearing aids
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: नि:शुल्क श्रवण जांच एवं श्रवण यंत्र
benefits.Benefit_Description: Free newborn hearing screening, free ear check-ups and free hearing aids for those with hearing loss. Detecting deafness early in a newborn prevents lifelong speech disability.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: नवजात शिशुओं की नि:शुल्क श्रवण जांच, कान की जांच एवं आवश्यकता होने पर नि:शुल्क श्रवण यंत्र। समय पर पहचान से बच्चे की वाणी बचाई जा सकती है।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Newborns, children and adults with hearing difficulty
benefits.Where_To_Avail: ENT department, Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura

benefits.Benefit_Title: Ayushman Arogya Mandir — 12 free health services near your home
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: आयुष्मान आरोग्य मंदिर — घर के पास 12 नि:शुल्क स्वास्थ्य सेवाएं
benefits.Benefit_Description: Your nearest Health Sub-Centre now provides twelve service packages free — pregnancy care, newborn and child care, immunisation, family planning, treatment of common illnesses, NCD screening, mental health, ENT, eye care, oral health, elderly care and emergency first aid.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: आपका नजदीकी उप-स्वास्थ्य केंद्र अब 12 प्रकार की सेवाएं नि:शुल्क देता है — गर्भावस्था देखभाल, नवजात एवं बाल देखभाल, टीकाकरण, परिवार नियोजन, सामान्य बीमारियों का इलाज, एनसीडी जांच, मानसिक स्वास्थ्य, नाक-कान-गला, नेत्र, दंत, वृद्धजन देखभाल एवं प्राथमिक उपचार।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Everyone — there is no eligibility condition
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir (Health Sub-Centre) or APHC — there is one in or near every panchayat
benefits.Documents_Required: ABHA number or Aadhaar is helpful

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free video consultation with a doctor (e-Sanjeevani)
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: चिकित्सक से नि:शुल्क वीडियो परामर्श (ई-संजीवनी)
benefits.Benefit_Description: Consult a qualified doctor or specialist by video from your local Ayushman Arogya Mandir, without travelling to the district hospital. The Community Health Officer sets up the call for you.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: अपने नजदीकी आयुष्मान आरोग्य मंदिर से वीडियो द्वारा विशेषज्ञ चिकित्सक से नि:शुल्क परामर्श — जिला अस्पताल जाने की आवश्यकता नहीं। सीएचओ आपकी कॉल जोड़ देंगे।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Everyone
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir (Health Sub-Centre) or APHC — ask the Community Health Officer

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free blood from the government blood bank
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: सरकारी ब्लड बैंक से नि:शुल्क रक्त
benefits.Benefit_Description: Blood is provided free to patients admitted in government facilities. Thalassaemia and sickle cell patients receive free lifelong transfusion support.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: सरकारी अस्पतालों में भर्ती मरीजों को नि:शुल्क रक्त। थैलेसीमिया एवं सिकल सेल रोगियों को आजीवन नि:शुल्क रक्त उपलब्ध।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Patients admitted in government facilities; thalassaemia and sickle cell patients
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Blood bank, Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura

benefits.Benefit_Title: Your ASHA — free health support in your own village
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: आपकी आशा दीदी — आपके गांव में नि:शुल्क स्वास्थ्य सहायता
benefits.Benefit_Description: Your ASHA accompanies pregnant women to hospital, brings medicines, tests for malaria, checks on newborns, mobilises children for immunisation, and helps you reach the right service. All of it is free.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: आशा दीदी गर्भवती महिला को अस्पताल ले जाती हैं, दवा पहुंचाती हैं, मलेरिया की जांच करती हैं, नवजात की देखभाल करती हैं एवं सही सेवा तक पहुंचाती हैं — सब नि:शुल्क।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Every household in the village
benefits.Where_To_Avail: In your own village — every village has an ASHA

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free 102 and 108 ambulance service
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: नि:शुल्क 102 एवं 108 एम्बुलेंस सेवा
benefits.Benefit_Description: Dial 102 for pregnant women and newborns, and 108 for any medical emergency or accident. The ambulance is free, comes to where you are, and drops you home after discharge.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: गर्भवती महिला एवं नवजात हेतु 102, तथा किसी भी आपात स्थिति या दुर्घटना हेतु 108 डायल करें। सेवा पूर्णत: नि:शुल्क है, एम्बुलेंस आपके पास आती है एवं छुट्टी के बाद घर छोड़ती है।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Anyone facing a medical emergency
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Call 102 or 108 from any phone, at any time

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free Drug Service — essential medicines at no cost
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: नि:शुल्क दवा सेवा — आवश्यक दवाइयां मुफ्त
benefits.Benefit_Description: Essential medicines are free at every government health facility. If a medicine on the essential list is not given to you, you are entitled to ask for it — you should not be sent to buy it outside.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: सभी सरकारी अस्पतालों में आवश्यक दवाइयां नि:शुल्क। यदि सूची की दवा न दी जाए तो मांगना आपका अधिकार है — बाहर से खरीदने के लिए कहा जाए तो शिकायत करें।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Every patient at a government facility
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Any government health facility in Sheikhpura — Sadar Hospital, CHC, PHC, APHC or Ayushman Arogya Mandir

benefits.Benefit_Title: Free Diagnostic Service — essential tests at no cost
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: नि:शुल्क जांच सेवा — आवश्यक जांच मुफ्त
benefits.Benefit_Description: Essential laboratory tests and radiology are free at government facilities — blood tests, urine tests, X-ray, ECG and ultrasound where available.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: सरकारी अस्पतालों में आवश्यक जांच नि:शुल्क — रक्त, मूत्र, एक्स-रे, ईसीजी तथा उपलब्धता अनुसार अल्ट्रासाउंड।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Every patient at a government facility
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Any government health facility in Sheikhpura — Sadar Hospital, CHC, PHC, APHC or Ayushman Arogya Mandir

benefits.Benefit_Title: Complain if a free service is denied or you are charged
benefits.Benefit_Title_HI: नि:शुल्क सेवा न मिलने या पैसा मांगे जाने पर शिकायत करें
benefits.Benefit_Description: If you are charged for something that should be free, refused treatment, or treated badly at a government facility, you have the right to complain. Call 104 or use the grievance desk.
benefits.Benefit_Description_HI: यदि नि:शुल्क सेवा के लिए पैसा मांगा जाए, इलाज से मना किया जाए या दुर्व्यवहार हो, तो शिकायत करना आपका अधिकार है। 104 पर कॉल करें।
benefits.Who_Is_Eligible: Any citizen
benefits.Where_To_Avail: Call 104, or the grievance desk at Sadar Hospital, Sheikhpura
benefits.Documents_Required: Name of the facility, date, and what happened
